newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France orders 10 Airbus, 10 Boeings -Le Monde.
newsitem.headline: Air France orders 10 Airbus, 10 Boeings -Le Monde.

text.p: The board of Air France has decided to order 10 Airbus A340 planes and place options for five more and also order 10 Boeing 777s, with options for 10 more, newspaper Le Monde reported on Wednesday.

The newspaper reported that the Boeing orders and options were worth a total $2.6 billion at catalogue prices, while the Airbus orders and options were estimated at around $2 billion. The Airbus options would be for a planned "stretched" version of the A340 wide-body plane, the report said.

Airbus Industrie is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
